QuestStart(20280, 1, 100, 0xE20000, 0, 0, false);
	QuestType(0, 0);
	QuestCompleteSave(false);
	QuestTitle("Universe Pro Pant 180 WIS +1");
	QuestLevel("LV 1");
	QuestAward("- Universe Pro Pant 180 WIS +1");
	QuestDesc("Upgrade your Universe Pro Items from +1 to +20.\\Read 'Explaination' for more information..");
	QuestShortDesc("Please refer 'Explaination' for the required items.");

	AddPhase(12, 1, "Talk To");
		Trigger_Start();
			Event_TheaterMode();
			Event_MsgBox("\\Hi there, Pro items can be upgrade by stages from +1 to +20. Each stages of upgrade will required different amount of Din Din Stone .\\");
			Event_MsgBox("\\Please select 'Explaination' for more information about the required items.");
			Event_Phase(2);

	AddPhase(12, 2, "Bring required items.");
		Trigger_Talk(0x40009104);
			Event_TheaterMode();
			Event_Disappear(1, 63315, 0);
			Event_Disappear(10, 33027, 0);
			Event_Get(1, 63316);
			Event_MsgBox("\\Congratulations, your item successful upgraded.");
			Event_MsgBox("\\Thank you for supporting Universe Wars!");
			Event_End();
		Else();
			Event_MsgBox("\\Sorry, you dont have all the required items.");
QuestEnd();
